 ORDER
This first bail application under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure has been filed on behalf of applicant-Mohit Kushwaha for grant of bail, pending the trial.
The applicant has been arrested in connection with Crime No.407/2022 of P.S. Uchehara District Satna (M.P.) for commission of offence under Sections 354, 294, 323, 506B and 376 of IPC.
He is in detention since 06.08.2022.
Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that applicant has not committed any offence.
He is innocent.
He has been falsely implicated.
He never committed any rape/aggravated penetrative sexual assault upon the prosecutrix.
A false story has been cocked up as prosecutrix had conceived from someone else.

It is further submitted that in DNA report applicant has not been found the Mohit Kushwaha vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 20 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/111708173/
1 biological father of of the child delivered by the prosecutrix.

sentences.text: As applicant has been roped in a false and fabricated case, he be released on bail.
On the other hand, learned counsel for the State has fairly admitted that in DNA report applicant has not been found the biological father of the new born child delivered by the prosecutrix.
I have gone through the DNA report and in it the prosecutrix has been found the mother of the new born child but applicant has not been found the biological father of the new born child.

Therefore,
looking to the fact and circumstances of the case including the DNA report, I am of the view that it is a case in which further pretrial detention of the applicant/accused is not warranted.

Consequently,
this first bail application under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of bail filed on behalf of applicant, stands allowed.

It is directed that applicant - Mohit Kushwaha be released on bail on h is furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.
He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C.
This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
Certified copy as per rules.
